draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.35, the 45th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 5th of 30 at LB. He went 41st overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Harold Landry. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 58 tackles in 2022, 19th of 30 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Jacksonville Jaguars (practice squad). 25 career games and 0 starts over 2 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 0 AV in 2025 against a career-best 1 in 2023. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (0th percentile), tackles for loss 1 (17th percentile). Played 8 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-3 edge rusher who played: 1.0 sacks against a median of 2.0, below the norm.
